# hyperlite_role (Data Source)

A role, predefined (`drive`, `operator`, `manager`...) or custom, to assign it (`hyperlite_acl.role = data.hyperlite_role.x.key`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hyperlite_role" "operator" {
  name = "operator"
}

resource "hyperlite_acl" "alice_operates_web" {
  subject_type  = "user"
  subject       = "alice"
  role          = data.hyperlite_role.operator.key
  resource_type = "vm"
  resource      = "web-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A predefined role's key, or a custom role's name.

### Read-Only

- `custom` (Boolean) A custom role.
- `id` (String) Its key.
- `key` (String) What an assignment names it by.
- `privileges` (Set of String) What it allows.
